start.t: {gold}🐔💣 The bomb is on a chicken this round!{default} Press {green}E{default} next to it to lead it, then escort it to a bombsite. It lays the bomb there for you to plant.
start.ct: {gold}🐔💣 A chicken is carrying the bomb!{default} Shoot it to make it panic and run, or press {green}E{default} next to it to scare it.
handler.you: {green}You're leading the courier.{default} Get it to a bombsite and stay close while it lays the bomb.
handler.you.auto: {green}The courier is following you now.{default} Get it to a bombsite and stay close while it lays the bomb.
handler.lost: {orange}The courier lost its handler{default} ({0}). Press {green}E{default} next to it to lead it.
handler.panicking: It's panicking! Wait for it to calm down.
lay.start.t: {gold}The courier is laying the bomb at {0}!{default} Stay close and keep it safe.
lay.start.ct: {red}The courier is laying the bomb at {0}!{default} Stop it!
lay.stopped: {orange}Laying interrupted!{default} Keep the courier in the site with you nearby.
laid.t: {gold}💣 The bomb is laid at {0}!{default} Pick it up and plant it!
laid.ct: {red}💣 The courier laid the bomb at {0}!{default} Stop the plant!
dropped.t: {orange}The panicking courier dropped the bomb!{default} Grab it and plant it yourself.
dropped.ct: {gold}The courier dropped the bomb in its panic!{default} Guard it!
panic.ct: {gold}You broke the courier's nerve!{default} It's running off in a panic.
panic.t: {red}{0} scared the courier off!{default} It panics for {1}s; get it back after that.
calm: The courier has calmed down. Press {green}E{default} next to it to lead it again if it wandered off.
status.inactive.map: Chicken Courier isn't used on this map.
status.inactive.players: Not enough players for Chicken Courier this round.
status.none: There's no courier right now (it laid the bomb, or the round hasn't started).
